falseSynonyms.zh: goal = the result you want to achieve purpose = the reason you are doing something Compare: - Our goal is to reduce errors by 30%. - The purpose of the new system is to improve safety.
falseSynonyms.point: goal = the result you want to achieve purpose = the reason you are doing something Compare: - Our goal is to reduce errors by 30%. - The purpose of the new system is to improve safety.

falseSynonyms.zh: A target is usually more measurable. Compare: - goal: improve customer satisfaction - target: achieve a satisfaction score of 90% A target is often one concrete expression of a broader goal.
falseSynonyms.point: A target is usually more measurable. Compare: - goal: improve customer satisfaction - target: achieve a satisfaction score of 90% A target is often one concrete expression of a broader goal.

falseSynonyms.zh: objective is more formal and specific. Compare: - general goal: improve English - learning objective: use ten new academic words correctly
falseSynonyms.point: objective is more formal and specific. Compare: - general goal: improve English - learning objective: use ten new academic words correctly

falseSynonyms.zh: A dream is something desired. A plan explains how you intend to achieve something. Compare: - My dream is to open a café. - My plan is to save $20,000 and open one within three years.
falseSynonyms.point: A dream is something desired. A plan explains how you intend to achieve something. Compare: - My dream is to open a café. - My plan is to save $20,000 and open one within three years.

falseSynonyms.zh: ambition does not automatically mean greed. A person can be ambitious about: - becoming a doctor - helping a community - mastering a skill - building a business Greed specifically involves excessive desire, especially for money or possessions.
falseSynonyms.point: ambition does not automatically mean greed. A person can be ambitious about: - becoming a doctor - helping a community - mastering a skill - building a business Greed specifically involves excessive desire, especially for money or possessions.

falseSynonyms.zh: These look similar but are different. aspiration = a hope or ambition inspiration = something that motivates or gives ideas Compare: - Her aspiration is to become a teacher. - Her mother was her inspiration.
falseSynonyms.point: These look similar but are different. aspiration = a hope or ambition inspiration = something that motivates or gives ideas Compare: - Her aspiration is to become a teacher. - Her mother was her inspiration.

falseSynonyms.zh: intention = what you mean or plan to do goal = the result you want Compare: - I intend to study every evening. - My goal is to pass the exam.
falseSynonyms.point: intention = what you mean or plan to do goal = the result you want Compare: - I intend to study every evening. - My goal is to pass the exam.

falseSynonyms.zh: hope = what you want to happen expectation = what you think is likely to happen Compare: - I hope we win. - I expect the match to be close. You can hope for something you do not expect.
falseSynonyms.point: hope = what you want to happen expectation = what you think is likely to happen Compare: - I hope we win. - I expect the match to be close. You can hope for something you do not expect.
